title: lnkiai/m3e-canvas
why_read: A niche design-to-prompt tool for Material 3 UI sketches, interesting mainly to frontend/design engineering practitioners exploring vibe-coding workflows.
analysis: This tool lets designers sketch Material 3 Expressive UI screens in-browser and convert them into prompts for AI code generation, sitting at the intersection of design tooling and LLM-assisted coding. It's a reasonably novel workflow idea but the description is thin and the technical depth of the repo itself is unclear from what's given. Interest is moderate for UI/design-focused engineers experimenting with AI-assisted frontend development.
